svg.text: USB-C > TP4056 > LiPo > AP2112K 3.3 V | panel switched by P-FET + N-FET
1. Panel power: GPIO10 -> 10k -> 2N7002 gate, 100k pull-up on P-FET gate (panel OFF at boot)
2. Battery 500 mAh (200 mAh is too small for a 30-day target)
3. Battery sense: 1M / 1M + 10 nF divider on GPIO3 (ADC1)
4. Decoupling: 1 uF at LDO, 10 uF + 100 nF at panel, 100 nF at MCU 3V3
5. One star ground point; no return current through signal wires
7. Prototype feeds 3V3 pad directly. Product: use ESP32-C3-MINI-1
